choices.content: A quadrilateral with perpendicular diagonals is a rhombus
A parallelogram with equal diagonals is a rhombus
A quadrilateral with all 4 sides equal is a rhombus
A quadrilateral with a pair of equal adjacent sides is a rhombus

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is true?

solutions.explanation: A quadrilateral with all 4 sides equal is a rhombus. A quadrilateral with perpendicular diagonals or a pair of equal adjacent sides is not necessarily a parallelogram. A parallelogram with equal diagonals is a rectangle.
solutions.title: Identify the sufficient condition
